crossRefs.note: Going on from there, he saw two other brothers, James the son of Zebedee, and John his brother, in the boat with…
Going on a little further from there, he saw James the son of Zebedee, and John, his brother, who were also in the boat…

translations.web: He saw two boats standing by the lake, but the fishermen had gone out of them, and were washing their nets.
translations.bsb: He saw two boats at the edge of the lake. The fishermen had left them and were washing their nets.
translations.kjv: And saw two ships standing by the lake: but the fishermen were gone out of them, and were washing their nets.
translations.asv: and he saw two boats standing by the lake: but the fishermen had gone out of them, and were washing their nets.
